answer: 正文文字的对比度至少需要 4.5:1，即 1.4.3 对比度（最低）的 AA 级要求。若要达到 AAA 级，则需至少 7:1，即 1.4.6 对比度（增强）。

points.text: 达到 AA 级（1.4.3 对比度（最低））时，正文至少需要 4.5:1。
points.quote: has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
points.title: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
points.source_text:
The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:
Large Text:
Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1;
Incidental:
Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component, that are pure decoration, that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant other visual content, have no contrast requirement.
Logotypes:
Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

points.text: 达到 AAA 级（1.4.6 对比度（增强））时，正文至少需要 7:1。
points.quote: has a contrast ratio of at least 7:1
points.title: 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)
points.source_text:
The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 7:1, except for the following:
Large Text:
Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1;
Incidental:
Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component, that are pure decoration, that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant other visual content, have no contrast requirement.
Logotypes:
Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

points.text: 只有大字体才能适用较低的 3:1（AA 级）；标准说明 18 点或 14 点加粗文字才算大字体，因此普通正文不适用 3:1。
points.quote: 18 point text or 14 point bold text is judged to be large enough to require a lower contrast ratio
points.title: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
points.source_text: Text that is larger and has wider character strokes is easier to read at lower contrast. The contrast requirement for larger text is therefore lower. This allows authors to use a wider range of color choices for large text, which is helpful for design of pages, particularly titles. 18 point text or 14 point bold text is judged to be large enough to require a lower contrast ratio. (See The American Printing House for the Blind Guidelines for Large Printing and The Library of Congress Guidelines for Large Print under Resources). "18 point" and "bold" can both have different meanings in different fonts but, except for very thin or unusual fonts, they should be sufficient. Since there are so many different fonts, the general measures are used and a note regarding thin or unusual fonts is included in the definition for large-scale text.
